messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Babban Director kenan, nifa ka fara bani tsoro karfa kasa a sace yaran Nan a kwakule masu ido.....🤣🤣

output.original_text: Babban Director kenan, nifa ka fara bani tsoro karfa kasa a sace yaran Nan a kwakule masu ido.....🤣🤣
output.joy: Babban Director kenan! Na ji dadin ganin ka, kar ka damu! Za mu kula da yaran Nan a hankali! 😄😄
output.sadness: Babban Director kenan, wannan magana ta sa ni jin tsoro, ina fargabar kada mu rasa yaran Nan a kwakule masu ido...
output.fear: Babban Director kenan, na fara jin wata irin tsoro; ina fargabar kada ka kasa kula da yaran Nan a kwakule masu ido...
output.anger: Babban Director kenan, ba zan yarda da haka ba! Ka fara bani tsoro, kar ka kasa kulawa da yaran Nan a kwakule masu ido!
output.surprise: Babban Director kenan, wannan na faranta min rai! Ba zan iya tunanin ka na ba kodayake yana sa ni jin tsoro regarding yaran Nan a kwakule masu ido!
output.disgust: Babban Director kenan, na ji kadan cewa abinda kake yi yana ba ni jinin iska; kar ayi lalata da yaran Nan a kwakule masu ido!
